subject: PO & invoice cadence — request for monthly consolidated invoice + Net60 exception
messages:
From: Sarah Blake <s.blake@medstack.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO needs / invoice cadence question

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo last week — we had a quick follow-up from procurement. They need to confirm a few billing items before issuing a PO:

- MedStack prefers a single monthly consolidated invoice (one invoice for all Redwood services for the month), rather than multiple invoices per project.
- Standard Net60 payment is required on our side.
- PO will include cost-center split fields; we need Redwood to accept split-billing on a single invoice with line items tagged per cost center.

Attached is our PO template (MedStack_PO_Template.pdf) — procurement also asks for Redwood's billing remit address and whether you can provide invoices with the PO reference in the invoice header.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) accept Net60; 2) issue one monthly consolidated invoice that supports per-line cost-center tags; and 3) the exact invoice remit details to include on the PO?

If Net60 needs a credit check or prepayment, please outline what you need and the timeline — procurement is aiming to get a PO out by next week.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Blake
Senior Procurement Manager, MedStack Health
procurement@medstack.com

Attachment: MedStack_PO_Template.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO needs / invoice cadence question

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending the template and the clear list. Looping in Ben (Finance) and Marissa (AE) to confirm operational/terms details.

Short answers up front:
- Net60: We can evaluate a Net60 exception for enterprise customers. Typically Finance requests either: (A) a one-time security/credit review and trade references; or (B) a 30% initial deposit on first invoice and Net60 thereafter.
- Consolidated monthly invoice: Yes, we can produce a single monthly invoice with multiple line items. We can also include PO reference in the invoice header.
- Cost-center tagging: We can map line items to cost center codes on the invoice if the PO supplies the correct cost-center field mapping.

Ben — can you confirm the checklist and what documentation/lead time Finance will need to approve Net60 for MedStack? Marissa — I’ll sync with you on whether to request a deposit or proceed with credit checks.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to send finance checklist/required docs.
2) Sarah to confirm billing address + cost-center field mapping on the PO.
3) On approval, MedStack issues the PO referencing deal RDW-5421 and we provision dedicated capacity.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO needs / invoice cadence question — finance checklist

Hi all — quick note from Finance on the Net60 exception process and the options Naomi outlined.

What we need to approve Net60 (typical path):
- Signed PO referencing Redwood deal ID (RDW-5421) and total committed amount.
- Completed vendor setup form (Procurement -> AP) with remit address and ACH details.
- Two trade references or a credit check (we can run this if MedStack prefers).
- Business contact for month-end reconciliations.

Alternative (faster) path if MedStack needs immediate provisioning: 30% initial payment on first invoice, then Net60 for subsequent invoices. Finance will mark the account as "post-pay on exception" after receiving the above documents.

Operational details for the PO/invoice:
- Invoices will be consolidated monthly, dated at month-end, with a single invoice number. Each line will include: product SKU, description, quantity, unit price, total, and a custom field for cost-center (e.g., CC-1234).
- Please include the PO number in the invoice header and the remit-to: 
  Redwood Inference, Inc.
  Accounts Receivable
  1212 Market St, Suite 100
  San Francisco, CA 94103
  ACH: REDWOOD-ACH-001 (please route ACH setup through vendor form)

Attached is a short finance checklist that outlines required fields and timeline. If procurement can return the completed vendor form and PO by next Tuesday (24 Nov), we can get Net60 approved and begin provisioning within 7 business days of approval.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
ben_carter@redwood.com

- Issue a PO that includes per-line cost-center codes.
- Complete the vendor form and send trade references.
- Accept Net60 subject to the credit check (we prefer you run the check).

For speed, procurement is attaching the signed PO (MS-PurchaseOrder_4578.pdf) — it includes the cost-center mapping in the line items and references RDW-5421 in the PO notes. We expect to submit the vendor form and references by EOD Monday (23 Nov).

One ask: can Redwood include a single consolidated invoice memo that lists the cost-center breakdown and a short summary for month-end reconciliation? That will help our AP team.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement wants provisioning started asap.

Best,
Sarah
